title: Deceleration matching and derivative audit
faithful_claim: Selected Union3 cubic-y/log reconstructions show a low-z best-fit feature interpreted as slowing acceleration.

equations.expression: E(z)=E_fid(z) exp[integral_0^min(z,z_c) delta q(s)/(1+s) ds]; exact same-parameter high-z recovery requires I_c=0
equations.locator: reviewer integration of source Eqs.(1),(3), cutoff after Eq.(3)
equations.definitions: E=H/H0, E_fid is the same-parameter fiducial LCDM H/H0; delta q=q-q_fid. z_c is the imposed cutoff, I_c the integral to that cutoff. Cosmic proper time satisfies dt/dz=-1/[(1+z)H]; j=a_dddot/(aH^3), q=-a_ddot/(aH^2).
equations.domain: Expanding FLRW kinematics with a0=1 and matched fiducial normalization. Early radiation/recombination and statistical derivative validity remain unresolved.

equations.locator: reviewer identities from source Eq.(1), not jerk equations presented by authors

equations.domain: Expanding FLRW kinematics with a0=1 and matched fiducial normalization. Early radiation/recombination and statistical derivative validity remain unresolved.

assumptions: Flat LambdaCDM fiducial with radiation omitted in the displayed late-time q formula; cubic/quartic finite interpolation in z, y or ln(1+z).
Uniform nodes in chosen coordinate; n+1 nodes, n free deviations and endpoint zero at z_c=2.5; uniform node priors [-1,1].
DESI DR2 BAO plus Planck compressed distance summaries and one SN compilation; high-z matching normalization is underspecified, and physical/perturbation closure is absent.
q=-a_ddot/(aH^2); z increases toward the past, dt/dz=-1/[(1+z)H].
Named best-fit feature occurs for BC+Union3 cubic-y/cubic-log without SH0ES and disappears in the corresponding plus-H0 curves.
No jerk posterior, derivative covariance or physical theory is supplied; weaker-than-fiducial q0 and time evolution of acceleration are distinct claims.

minimal_test.question: Recover the author q-to-H implementation and high-z normalization before inference. At fixed fiducial parameters check E(0)=1, continuity at z_c, integrated I_c and radiation/early-physics matching. Then evaluate qdot, j and j+q separately across coordinate/order/cutoff/SH0ES choices using complete joint parameter samples; test derivative claims with uncertainty, rather than differentiating only a best-fit plot.
minimal_test.scope: Conceptual source/method test only. Values, implementation, production tolerances and accepted consumer inputs remain unspecified.

simplifications: No physical dark-energy theory or perturbation closure.
No CMB likelihood validation, numerical refit or claimed detection/end of acceleration from this source review.
data_dependencies: DESI DR2 BAO ratios/covariance; Planck-derived distance-prior compression; one published SN reduction at a time; optional SH0ES Gaussian prior. Assets and joint cross-covariance are not supplied locally.
unknowns: Author high-z integration/matching implementation and radiation handling.
Full posterior samples/derivative covariance and statistical regularity.
Distance-prior compression validity for the chosen continuation.
verification_gates: Reconcile source conventions and maintain the original-versus-repaired equation distinction.
Inspect current compiled consumer capabilities and freeze inputs/reference cases before constructing any executable request.
Keep analytic/numerical verification, observation lineage, inference validity and scientific interpretation separate.
falsification: A discontinuous E at the cutoff or claimed exact same-parameter recovery with nonzero I_c rejects that matching prescription. A q upturn alone cannot establish j<0, j+q<0 or an acceleration endpoint.
